errors.description: Incorrect logical equivalence stated; (¬A → B) is equivalent to (A ∨ B), not (A ∨ ¬B).
Incorrectly states that (¬A → B) is equivalent to (A ∨ ¬B) instead of (A ∨ B), which is a factual error in propositional logic.
The step incorrectly interprets the logical equivalence by asserting (¬A → B) is equivalent to (A ∨ ¬B) without verification, which is false as (¬A → B) actually translates to (A ∨ B).
